name: Kaki Bukit
intro: Kaki Bukit is an industrial estate in the East region, around Kaki Bukit Avenue and Kaki Bukit Road, with many workshops, trade units and parts suppliers.

name: Ubi
intro: Ubi is an industrial area near Paya Lebar in the Geylang planning area (Central region), around Ubi Avenue and Ubi Road, with motor workshops mixed in among light industry.

name: Eunos
intro: Eunos is a mixed residential and industrial area in the Geylang planning area (Central region), close to Paya Lebar, Ubi and Kaki Bukit.

name: Bedok North
intro: Bedok North is an industrial pocket in the East region, around Bedok North Avenue and Bedok North Street.

name: Tampines
intro: Tampines is a town in the East region with light industrial parks around Tampines Street 92 and 93.

name: Changi and Loyang
intro: Changi and Loyang cover the industrial areas at the east end of Singapore, around Loyang Way and Changi South.

name: Woodlands
intro: Woodlands is the main industrial area in the north-west, around Woodlands Industrial Park and the Woodlands Avenue roads, close to the Causeway.

name: Kranji
intro: Kranji is an industrial area in the north-west, around Kranji Way, Jalan Lam Huat and Sungei Kadut.

name: Yishun
intro: Yishun has two main motor trade clusters, Yishun Industrial Park A and the Yishun Industrial Street 1 area around North Spring Bizhub.

name: Sembawang and Admiralty
intro: Sembawang and Admiralty are neighbourhoods in the north of Singapore, along roads such as Sembawang Road.

name: Ang Mo Kio
intro: Ang Mo Kio has a long-running industrial estate, Ang Mo Kio Industrial Park, with workshops serving the north-east.

name: Serangoon North
intro: Serangoon North is an industrial and residential area in the North-East region, around Serangoon North Avenue.

name: Defu and Hougang
intro: Defu and Hougang cover the Defu Lane industrial area and the Hougang neighbourhood in the North-East region.

name: Sengkang
intro: Sengkang and nearby Punggol are newer residential towns in the North-East region.

name: Sin Ming and Bishan
intro: Sin Ming and Bishan take in the Sin Ming Industrial Estate and the Bishan area in the middle of Singapore.

name: Toa Payoh
intro: Toa Payoh has an industrial park and trade units in the Central region, close to Bishan and MacPherson.

name: MacPherson
intro: MacPherson is an area in the Central region around MacPherson Road, close to Ubi and Paya Lebar.

name: Jalan Besar and Kallang Bahru
intro: Jalan Besar and Kallang Bahru are central areas with a long history of motor trade units and workshops.

name: Newton and Novena
intro: Newton and Novena sit just north of Orchard Road in the Central region, around Newton Circus and Bukit Timah Road.

name: Alexandra and Bukit Merah
intro: Alexandra and Bukit Merah cover the south side of the Central region, around Alexandra Road, Bukit Merah and Henderson.

name: Toh Guan and Jurong East
intro: Toh Guan and Jurong East are in the West region, around Toh Guan Road East and the Enterprise Hub industrial building.

name: Jurong West
intro: Jurong West is a large area in the West region with industrial units alongside housing estates.

name: Pandan Loop
intro: Pandan Loop is a small industrial area in the West region, near Clementi and Jurong East.

name: Bukit Batok
intro: Bukit Batok has industrial parks in the West region, including Bukit Batok Industrial Park A.

name: Tuas
intro: Tuas is the industrial area at the far west of Singapore, around Tuas Avenue and Tuas South.
